entries.subject: Orbit
entries.finding: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table: P 15.337597 d (Mistry et al. 2023); a/R* 32.393 (Mistry et al. 2023); inclination 89.27 degrees (Mistry et al. 2023); no archive row states an eccentricity; the orbit is taken as circular; transit mid-time 2459037.3678 BJD, taken as BJD_TDB (Mistry et al. 2023). Display convention: transit photometry does not measure the orbit's position angle on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north).
